about_page_what_content:
Pronounced "kuh-ur-lhya", Comhairle is an online platform designed to make it much easier for people to participate in how decisions are made in government and public life. Public consultations often end up as box-ticking exercises, difficult for everyday people to access or influence. Cormhairle enables policymakers to quickly set up engaging, accessible participation processes. Comhairle enables participants to see the impact of their contributions on decisions.

Importantly, Comhairle doesn’t aim to replace the role of skilled facilitators or the value of human conversation. Instead, it supports them, making it easier and more rewarding for both the public and organisers to get involved. The platform helps guide people through structured discussions on policies or challenges, using AI-enhanced features that summarise feedback and make sense of complex topics.

Ultimately, Comhairle is all about helping more people have a real say in decisions that affect their lives, supporting better, fairer outcomes.
about_page_who_content: CrownShy was started in 2024 to operate at the crossroads of technology, facilitation practices, and dialogue, with a mission of empowering individuals, groups, and societies to collectively self-govern. Our team brings decades of expertise spanning collective intelligence, facilitation, civic technologies, process and interface design, artificial intelligence, participatory science, social movements and grassroots organizing. We specialize in designing comprehensive, end-to-end systems that elevate and expand democratic practices all while prioritizing meaningful human connection.

privacy_intro: To execute the functionality of the website and provide accountability and moderation, we collect and associate responses on the platform with one of the following account types:
privacy_email_title: An user provided email and username

privacy_anon_body: Where permission is given we will publish responses potentially with attribution. We will never publish email addresses or other PII information.
privacy_access_body1: You can access your personal information and perform actions like downloading a copy of it, or correcting it if it is wrong, in your user preferences. If you have further questions or requests about the information you have submitted please contact team@crown-shy.com.

a11y_run_by: This website is run by CrownShy. We want as many people as possible to be able to use this website. For example, that means you should be able to:
a11y_can1: Change colours, contrast levels and fonts using browser or device settings
a11y_can2: Zoom in up to 400% without the text spilling off the screen
a11y_can3: Navigate most of the website using a keyboard or speech recognition software
a11y_can4: Listen to most of the website using a screen reader (including the most recent versions of JAWS, NVDA and VoiceOver)
a11y_abilitynet_pre: We've also made the website text as simple as possible to understand.
a11y_abilitynet_post: has advice on making your device easier to use if you have a disability.

a11y_outofscope_heading: Content that's not within the scope of the accessibility regulations
a11y_outofscope_body: Comhairle integrates a number of third-party open source tools as part of its participation platform. The accessibility of interfaces provided directly by those tools is outside our direct control. We aim to ensure that all surfaces directly owned and maintained by CrownShy meet the required standard.
a11y_improving_heading: What we're doing to improve accessibility
a11y_improving_body: We are actively developing Comhairle and accessibility improvements are part of our regular development cycle. Our frontend is built using Svelte and Shadcn, a component library that provides accessible defaults, and Tailwind CSS for styling. We intend to carry out a more comprehensive accessibility audit as the platform matures.
a11y_prep_line1: This statement was prepared on 5th March 2026. It was last reviewed on 5th March 2026.
a11y_prep_line2: This website was last tested on 5th March 2026 against the WCAG 2.2 AA standard.
a11y_prep_line3: The test was carried out by the CrownShy development team. The most viewed pages were tested using automated testing tools. A further internal review of the website was carried out against the WCAG 2.2 AA standard.
